Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is his main source of damage, so when you see the cast animation, move beyond the blade’s edge or close in toward him. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave its area immediately. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, create distance and wait out its duration.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If healing makes the duel drag on, build resistances first, then get healing reduction.
Aatrox.fight: Use Jax E Counter Strike to dodge basic attacks and minion attacks, then stun Aatrox and trade briefly with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Don’t rely on Jax E Counter Strike to handle Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade; move to avoid the blade’s edge.
Aatrox.laning: When Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown, farm from outside Aatrox’s range. Before trading, build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault.
Aatrox.combo: If you engage after Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first so you can stun almost as soon as you land. If you use Jax Q Leap Strike first, Aatrox can escape with Aatrox E Umbral Dash.
Aatrox.escape: Right after you make Aatrox use Aatrox E Umbral Dash is your chance to close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, leave its area immediately before it pulls you in, and save Jax Q Leap Strike as an escape for this situation.
Aatrox.phase: Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and item strength become more valuable in the late game, so limit early losses and buy time.
Aatrox.teamfight: Follow up after your allies’ crowd control or engage. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies away to respond.

Akali.watch: Once marked, the second dash follows you along your escape path.
Akali.build: Akali’s main damage is magic damage, so get magic resistance first. If Jax is dying first to her magic burst, choose Banshee’s Veil.
Akali.fight: After that, build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault in advance, and fight back when Akali comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack or uses a mobility skill. Don’t rely on Jax E Counter Strike alone to withstand Akali’s ability damage. Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms when you commit to a fight.
Akali.laning: Build a health and CS lead while Akali R Perfect Execution is unavailable.
Akali.combo: If Akali still has a mobility skill, don’t start with Jax Q Leap Strike. Hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault, then start trading with movement. Press Jax W Empower before the first basic attack animation ends to land the next attack quickly.
Akali.escape: Don’t engage deeply just because Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip is down. Check her remaining mobility skills too, and look to engage especially before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back: activate Jax E Counter Strike, then close in with Jax Q Leap Strike and stun her.
Akali.phase: In the late game, keep attacking with stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault and your items.
Akali.teamfight: Follow up after your allies’ crowd control or engage. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies away to respond.

Amumu.watch: Amumu Q Bandage Toss stops at the first target, so dodge it by moving unpredictably with minions between you. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns all nearby enemies, so don’t group with allies while R is available. Amumu W Despair deals continuous damage based on your max health, so don’t stay near Amumu for long.
Amumu.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand Amumu’s magic damage instead of relying on health alone. Armor and magic resistance can’t reduce the true damage from Amumu P Cursed Touch. If you’re dying while caught by Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, get Sterak’s Gage to improve your chances of surviving.
Amumu.fight: Jax E Counter Strike can’t block enough of Amumu’s ability damage, so activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms when you commit to a fight. Before engaging, hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault.
Amumu.laning: When Jax E Counter Strike is unavailable, farm from outside Amumu’s range and stay behind minions to block Amumu Q Bandage Toss.
Amumu.combo: Use Jax W Empower right after a basic attack to quickly follow with the next one. If you’re already close, don’t use Jax Q Leap Strike first; save it to chase or escape.
Amumu.escape: The window after Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down is a good time to engage. Amumu has no skill to create distance, so when you have an opening, close in with Jax Q Leap Strike and follow up with the stun from Jax E Counter Strike.
Amumu.teamfight: While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, spread out from your allies and take fights in open areas. Make Amumu use it, then fight. Follow up after your allies engage, and activate Jax E Counter Strike before using Jax Q Leap Strike to look for an area stun on multiple enemies. If there’s no reason to start a fight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies over to respond.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when it returns, and that damage increases the more health you’ve lost. If you’re cursed, move out of the line between Aurora and yourself. If your health is low, retreat before the curse returns. When Aurora R Between Worlds appears, you’re slowed when leaving it, so decide before it’s cast whether to retreat or fight inside.
Aurora.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor against the damage from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, Q Twofold Hex, and E The Weirding. If you’re dying first to magic damage, choose Banshee’s Veil to block a setup ability. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on your max health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone.
Aurora.fight: Hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault before fighting. When you engage, activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms for magic resistance. Use Jax E Counter Strike to stun Aurora rather than to withstand her ability damage. If Aurora uses a mobility skill to create distance, check for any remaining mobility skills before closing in again.
Aurora.laning: Don’t use Jax E Counter Strike just to poke. While it’s on cooldown, stay out of Aurora’s range, even if you have to give up CS. Position yourself where Aurora has to pass by Jax to return to her turret; this gives you a better angle to engage.
Aurora.combo: Use W right after your first basic attack to speed up your next attack.
Aurora.escape: Don’t rush your engage when only one mobility skill is down; Aurora can escape with her remaining skills.
Aurora.phase: In the late game, make use of stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault and your items, but don’t chase without checking Aurora’s mobility skills.
Aurora.teamfight: If Aurora uses her leap to engage and gets no takedown, it’s a chance to catch her. If an ally dies, Aurora W Across the Veil’s cooldown may reset, so don’t leave a low-health ally behind when you retreat.

Belveth.build: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal physical damage, so build armor first. If Bel'Veth's basic attacks and attack speed are a threat, use Frozen Heart to reduce her attack speed. Armor won't block the magic damage from Bel'Veth W Above and Below, and you need health, rather than resistances, to withstand the true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet.
Belveth.combo: To stop Bel'Veth from disengaging, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Jax W Empower resets your basic attack timer, so use it right after the first basic attack to land the next one quickly.
Belveth.escape: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below sideways to avoid its crowd control and prevent the reset on Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, then look for an opening to engage. Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has a separate cooldown for each direction, so while she can't immediately dash again in the direction she just used, activate Jax E Counter Strike, close in with Jax Q Leap Strike, and stun her. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet is also a mobility ability, so don't engage just because one charge of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is down.
Belveth.fight: Then build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault by hitting minions and start trades on foot, saving Jax Q Leap Strike to chase or disengage. If Bel'Veth uses Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom, don't pile on attacks while her damage taken is reduced.
Belveth.laning: If Jax E Counter Strike isn't ready, farm from outside enemy range. Build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault before trading. When you need a safe recall, you can push the wave with Jax E Counter Strike's area reactivation.
Belveth.phase: Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks are permanent, so it becomes harder to kill her the same way as the game goes on.
Belveth.teamfight: If an ally dies and leaves Void Coral, retreat before Bel'Veth can pick it up, and delay teamfights while she is transformed. If there's no reason to start a teamfight, push a turret in a side lane to draw a response from the enemy.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge's cooldown, so move sideways to dodge when Bel'Veth engages. Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces the damage she takes, so don't pile on attacks while it's active; interrupt it with Jax E Counter Strike's stun or attack after it ends. Jax E Counter Strike can dodge Bel'Veth's basic attacks.

Brand.build: Build magic resistance first against Brand’s damage. If magic damage is taking you down first, consider Banshee’s Veil. Brand P Blaze scales with your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Brand.combo: When engaging, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike during the leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. If you could safely hit minions, first build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault.
Brand.escape: Brand has no movement ability, so you have an opening to engage if he remains in range just after using Brand W Pillar of Flame. If Brand P Blaze is not applied, Brand Q Sear cannot stun you, so use that opening to close in with Jax Q Leap Strike. If Blaze is applied, dodge Brand Q Sear before engaging.
Brand.fight: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and Brand P Blaze is not applied, close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike. Activate Jax E Counter Strike just before engaging so the stun follows your landing, and activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms as you enter the fight to gain magic resistance. Once close, weave Jax W Empower between basic attacks to concentrate your damage.
Brand.laning: Don’t last-hit beside burning minions; step to the side of the wave, then move in. If Jax E Counter Strike is down, don’t stay within Brand’s range, even if it means giving up CS.
Brand.phase: Even later in the game, Jax E Counter Strike alone cannot block Brand’s ability damage, so time your engage and Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms together.
Brand.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies to limit the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the bounces of Brand R Pyroclasm. Follow your allies’ crowd control or engage; activate Jax E Counter Strike in advance, then use Jax Q Leap Strike to jump in and look for an area stun on multiple enemies. When you can hit several champions, activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms to gain armor and magic resistance.
Brand.watch: After Brand P Blaze is applied, taking another ability increases the stacking damage, so dodge his first ability, Brand Q Sear or Brand W Pillar of Flame. While Blaze is applied, Brand Q Sear can stun you, so step out of the projectile’s path or stand behind minions. Don’t count on Jax E Counter Strike to withstand Brand’s ability damage.

Briar.build: Build armor first against Briar’s main damage. If Briar Q Head Rush hits you, your resistances are lowered, so don’t rely on your resistance values alone. If Briar’s healing becomes a problem in a long duel, consider anti-heal after building resistances.
Briar.combo: When jumping on Briar, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike during the leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first so the stun lands almost as you land, leaving Briar less time to escape with a movement ability.
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down; check whether Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and Briar R Certain Death are also available. In particular, before Briar R Certain Death comes back up, wait until she has used her movement and crowd-control abilities, then activate Jax E Counter Strike and close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Briar.fight: After closing in, make a short trade with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack, and avoid fighting while Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown.
Briar.laning: In areas without vision, don’t stand in the middle of the lane for long. When Jax E Counter Strike is unavailable, farm from outside her range. If you need to recall safely, you can push the wave with Jax E Counter Strike’s area reactivation.
Briar.teamfight: While Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack is active, she attacks the nearest enemy, so take the frontline position to protect your backline carries. If Briar R Certain Death targets you, move toward your allies and fight back together. Follow your allies’ engage by activating Jax E Counter Strike in advance, then use Jax Q Leap Strike to jump into a group of enemies and look for an area stun.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush stuns and lowers armor and magic resistance, so manage your distance to avoid it. When Briar charges in with W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, use Jax E Counter Strike to dodge her basic attacks. When Briar charges E Chilling Scream, don’t stand with your back to a wall, and look for a chance to interrupt the charge with Jax E Counter Strike’s stun.

Camille.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, W Tactical Sweep, and E Hookshot. Armor cannot reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and W Tactical Sweep scales with maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone. If Camille’s basic attacks and attack speed are a threat, use Frozen Heart to reduce her attack speed.
Camille.combo: For a short trade at close range, quickly use basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Time Jax E Counter Strike to activate as Camille Q Precision Protocol’s empowered basic attack comes in.
Camille.escape: Camille E Hookshot being down is your chance to engage, but account for Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum still being available as an escape with that movement ability. In particular, before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back up, close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike and follow with Jax E Counter Strike’s stun. You can also use Jax Q Leap Strike to escape to a minion or ward.
Camille.fight: After that, hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault, then trade once Camille P Adaptive Defenses’ shield has worn off. Avoid fighting if Jax E Counter Strike isn’t ready, and farm from outside her range.
Camille.laning: Stand between minions, away from walls, and avoid positions where Camille E Hookshot can corner you near a wall. If you need a safe recall, push the wave with the area reactivation damage from Jax E Counter Strike.
Camille.phase: From mid game onward, don’t leave the side lane unattended so you can stop Camille’s fast tower push. In the late game, use Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and your items to look for a front-to-front fight.
Camille.teamfight: When you can hit several champions, activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms to make use of the armor and magic resistance it grants. If there’s no reason to start a teamfight, push a tower in a side lane to draw a response from the enemy.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot can use walls to engage from long range and stun you, so stand away from walls. Don’t use a response ability as Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages; if you’re trapped, wait out the zone’s duration, then fight back.

Chogath.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Cho’Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. If magic damage is taking you down first, consider Banshee’s Veil to block his initiating ability. Resistances cannot reduce the true damage from Cho’Gath R Feast, and stacking only health makes Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes hurt more as well.
Chogath.combo: Before engaging, hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault.
Chogath.escape: Engage after dodging Cho’Gath Q Rupture or when W Feral Scream is down. Conversely, if Cho’Gath W Feral Scream silences you, don’t try to cast abilities; walk away first.
Chogath.fight: After that, hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault, then fight after dodging Cho’Gath Q Rupture or when W Feral Scream is down. Start the trade at close range and save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or disengaging.
Chogath.laning: Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes pierces minions, so don’t farm in a straight line behind them. Keep your distance when you can’t use Jax E Counter Strike, and look for an opening just after Cho’Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave.
Chogath.phase: As Cho’Gath builds R Feast stacks and durability over time, Jax becomes disadvantaged in the matchup, so pressure his scaling from the early game.
Chogath.teamfight: When you can hit several champions, activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms to gain armor and magic resistance. If there’s no need to start a teamfight, push a tower in a side lane to draw away Cho’Gath’s team’s responders.
Chogath.watch: When the ground indicator for Cho’Gath Q Rupture appears beneath you, dodge sideways immediately; use Jax Q Leap Strike to evade if needed. If Cho’Gath W Feral Scream silences you from the front, you can’t escape with Jax Q Leap Strike, so avoid facing him and walk away first. If your health is at half or lower, move out of range of Cho’Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.

Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius’s main damage. Darius E Apprehend’s armor penetration ignores some armor, and Darius R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage, so get health as well.
Darius.combo: If Darius E Apprehend is down and you can engage, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike during the leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Jax W Empower resets your basic attack timer, so press it before the first basic attack animation ends to land the next attack quickly.
Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown.
Darius.fight: Build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks on minions and make short trades. When Darius is about to basic attack, activate Jax E Counter Strike to dodge the attack and stun him, then back off before Hemorrhage stacks build up. An opening comes just after Darius uses Q Decimate to clear minions or misses E Apprehend.
Darius.laning: If you need a safe recall, you can push the wave with Jax E Counter Strike’s area reactivation.
Darius.phase: Even in the late game, avoid long fights where Darius P Hemorrhage reaches maximum stacks; fight briefly, then disengage so the stacks wear off.
Darius.teamfight: Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms from a position where you can hit several champions, and back off so you don’t give Darius a kill with R Noxian Guillotine while you’re low on health and have several stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow with basic attacks, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so move outside its range and save Jax Q Leap Strike to respond. When you see Darius Q Decimate, get outside the blade’s edge or stick close to reduce the damage and healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance; if you have several stacks and low health, get completely out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and W Heart Zapper deal magic damage, which armor won’t block, so account for them separately. If the duel runs long, consider anti-heal after building resistances.
DrMundo.combo: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, activate Jax E Counter Strike first, then engage with Jax Q Leap Strike. Reactivate Jax E Counter Strike during the leap to stun him as you land, then follow with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. If his passive is still available, it ignores the first stun, so don’t expect the stun to land with the same sequence.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so when Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and an opening appears, close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike. It’s a good time to approach when Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is blocked by minions or misses. Don’t spend time trying to hold him in place while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active.
DrMundo.fight: After that, hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault, then fight after blocking Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is still available, it ignores the first stun from Jax E Counter Strike, so don’t commit deeply assuming that stun will land.
DrMundo.laning: Save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or disengaging after starting the trade with movement instead of using it to close in first. Step on the canister Dr. Mundo drops as you retreat to deny its healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.phase: Even though Jax’s continuous attacks become strong in the late game, they may not be enough damage against Dr. Mundo if he builds both health and armor. While Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is ready, shift your gains to another lane or objective.
DrMundo.teamfight: Follow your allies’ engage or crowd control as the second one in; activate Jax E Counter Strike first, then use Jax Q Leap Strike to jump into a group of enemies. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is still available, account for it blocking Jax E Counter Strike’s stun against him. Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms as you engage to gain armor and magic resistance, and if there’s no reason to start a teamfight, pressure a tower in a side lane.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw only hits the first target and scales with current health, so be especially careful when your health is high and stand behind minions. Jax E Counter Strike can dodge the empowered basic attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, but it can’t avoid the damage from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, stop chasing, accounting for its healing and movement speed increase.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance first against Ekko’s magic damage. If magic damage combos are taking you down first, use Banshee’s Veil to block his initiating ability; if crowd control is locking you down and killing you, use Sterak’s Gage to survive.
Ekko.combo: Once you confirm that Ekko E Phase Dive and R Chronobreak are down, engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike during the leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Press Jax W Empower before the first basic attack animation ends to land the next attack quickly.
Ekko.escape: Don’t chase just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down; look for an opening when Ekko R Chronobreak is down too. Move outside Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s marked area to avoid the stun, then activate Jax E Counter Strike and close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Ekko.fight: After that, build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault and fight. Just after Ekko closes in with E Phase Dive, use Jax E Counter Strike to avoid his empowered basic attack and look for a stun. Don’t try to withstand ability damage with Jax E Counter Strike; time Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms for the main fight.
Ekko.laning: Preserve your health by dodging Ekko Q Timewinder’s return path and the marked area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence. Before the fight, hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault.
Ekko.phase: In the late game, make use of Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and the power of continuous attacks, but avoid reckless chases if Ekko R Chronobreak is ready.
Ekko.teamfight: Just after Ekko closes in with E Phase Dive, use Jax E Counter Strike to stun him and create a chance to force out Ekko R Chronobreak or interrupt his combo.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to deny its stun and shield. Ekko Q Timewinder can hit on its return path too, so watch the direction it was thrown and step aside. If you see Ekko’s afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even if he’s low on health.

Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main ability damage. If magic burst is killing you first, choose Banshee’s Veil. If Elise E Cocoon’s stun is catching and killing you, consider tenacity as well. Armor is also valuable because she deals basic attack damage.
Elise.combo: Use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Use Jax W Empower to reset your basic attack timer, and hit minions before engaging to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault.
Elise.escape: Right after you make Elise use Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite is an opportunity to close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike. If both Elise E Cocoon and E Rappel are down, activate Jax E Counter Strike and go in, looking for the stun. Don’t waste Jax Q Leap Strike while Elise is airborne with E Rappel; wait for her to land.
Elise.fight: Don’t use Jax E Counter Strike for a single poke. Build passive stacks first, then use it when you can reliably engage. Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms as you enter the fight to withstand ability damage.
Elise.laning: Keep ample vision early and don’t push the lane recklessly when Elise is out of sight. If Jax E Counter Strike is down, stay out of her range and give up CS if needed. Stand behind your minion wave to avoid Elise E Cocoon.
Elise.phase: Elise tries to build an advantage with early ganks, so it’s best to avoid giving up kills and stall for time. In the late game, fight using stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault and your items.
Elise.teamfight: Follow your allies’ engage or crowd control as the second one in. If you don’t need to start a teamfight, push a side lane tower to draw opponents away to respond.
Elise.watch: When Elise transforms with Elise R Spider Form, she is looking to finish you off, so be ready to use Jax Q Leap Strike and your defensive tools. Jax E Counter Strike dodges basic attacks but does not block damage from Elise’s abilities.

Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against Evelynn’s main damage. If magic damage is killing you first, choose Banshee’s Veil, but prioritize retreating before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures, since it reduces your resistances.
Evelynn.combo: To engage, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first and stun almost as soon as you land to leave Evelynn less room to escape with Evelynn E Whiplash or Evelynn R Last Caress.
Evelynn.escape: Don’t go in just because Evelynn E Whiplash is down; wait until Evelynn R Last Caress is down too. Close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike and catch her with Jax E Counter Strike’s stun, but retreat first if the mark from Evelynn W Allure is maturing.
Evelynn.fight: For short trades, build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault and attack with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Evelynn’s main damage comes from abilities, so don’t rely on Jax E Counter Strike to withstand it. Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms as you enter a fight to gain resistances.
Evelynn.teamfight: If Evelynn engages on your backline carries, catch her with Jax E Counter Strike’s AoE stun.
Evelynn.watch: When the mark from Evelynn W Allure appears, she’s nearby preparing a charm, so retreat before the mark matures and alert your allies. Evelynn E Whiplash after the charm deals damage based on your max health, and Evelynn R Last Caress is also dangerous at low health, so don’t stay somewhere without vision.

Fiddlesticks.build: If Fiddlesticks’ magic burst kills you first, prioritize Banshee’s Veil and build magic resistance. If you’re caught and killed by Fiddlesticks Q Terrify or Fiddlesticks E Reap’s silence, secure your survival with Sterak’s Gage. Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms when entering a fight to gain defensive stats.
Fiddlesticks.combo: After landing, attack with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack, using Jax W Empower to reset your basic attack timer. If Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest starts channeling, time Jax E Counter Strike’s reactivation for then.
Fiddlesticks.escape: Even after Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap’s silence are down, it’s a good time to close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike and land Jax E Counter Strike’s stun.
Fiddlesticks.fight: It’s best to close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike while Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down. Activate Jax E Counter Strike just before engaging to line up the stun with your landing, and if Fiddlesticks starts Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, interrupt the channel by reactivating E for the stun. Don’t count on Jax E Counter Strike to withstand Fiddlesticks’ magic damage.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault before starting a trade. If Jax E Counter Strike is down, farm outside Fiddlesticks’ ability range, give up CS if needed, and wait until it’s available again. If Fiddlesticks is out of sight, check the bushes behind the lane and watch for an ambush.
Fiddlesticks.phase: In the late game, make use of stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault and your items, but keep watching for Fiddlesticks ambushes from out of sight.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, Fiddlesticks E Reap, and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm all affect an area, so spread out from your allies and don’t group up on narrow paths without vision. If you can’t interrupt Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, get out of range.
Fiddlesticks.watch: If you see Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channeling, interrupt it with Jax E Counter Strike’s stun. If you can’t interrupt it, get out of range and avoid fighting until its duration ends. Watch for ambushes from bushes when Fiddlesticks is out of sight, and don’t pass near an unverified Fiddlesticks P A Harmless Scarecrow.

Fiora.build: Build armor first against Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. The true damage from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge can’t be reduced by armor. If the duel is prolonged, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances.
Fiora.combo: After Fiora W Riposte is down, activate Jax E Counter Strike and go in with Jax Q Leap Strike, then reactivate E mid-leap and follow with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. For a short trade when you’re already in range, use basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack.
Fiora.escape: Right after you make Fiora use Fiora Q Lunge is an opportunity to go in. Close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike and use Jax E Counter Strike, but be careful about reactivating it for the stun if Fiora W Riposte is still available.
Fiora.fight: Afterward, hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault, then bait out Fiora W Riposte and look for a stun with Jax E Counter Strike.
Fiora.laning: Stand opposite the vital to respond when Fiora dives in, and don’t chase recklessly after a short trade.
Fiora.teamfight: Follow your allies’ engage or crowd control and hit multiple enemies with Jax E Counter Strike’s AoE stun. If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stand against a wall to block one side’s vital and avoid exposing all four vitals.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte can block Jax E Counter Strike’s stun and stun Jax, so be careful about reactivating E while Riposte is available. Fiora Q Lunge can target the vital shown on your body, so stand on the opposite side of the vital and narrow her approach angle.

Gangplank.build: Since Gangplank Q Parrrley keeps poking you, build armor first starting in lane. Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage deal true damage that resistances can’t block, so you also need a good amount of health. If the fight is prolonged, consider Executioner’s Calling to counter healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy.
Gangplank.combo: After landing, attack with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack, using W to reset your basic attack timer.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance, so close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike right after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, as long as there are no mature kegs nearby. After Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, you have a chance to use Jax E Counter Strike’s stun. Delay your engage if you’d land in range of Gangplank E Powder Keg’s slow.
Gangplank.fight: There’s an opportunity to trade right after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, before it matures. Hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault, and if you can walk up, save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is available, he can cleanse Jax E Counter Strike’s stun, so engage after W is down when looking for a stun kill.
Gangplank.laning: Break a nearby Gangplank E Powder Keg if you can do so from outside its blast radius, and don’t approach mature kegs.
Gangplank.phase: In the late game, use stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault to keep up consecutive attacks, but don’t fight where Gangplank E Powder Keg has matured.
Gangplank.teamfight: Jax should follow his allies’ engage or crowd control and lock down multiple enemies with Jax E Counter Strike’s AoE stun. When there’s no reason to start a teamfight, push a side lane tower to draw opponents away to respond.
Gangplank.watch: Be more careful of explosions as Gangplank E Powder Keg matures. If there’s a mature keg nearby, retreat, and don’t step where two kegs overlap.

Garen.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice can’t be reduced by resistances, so consider your total health when trying to withstand it. If Garen’s basic attacks and attack speed are a problem, lower his attack speed with Frozen Heart.
Garen.combo: Follow up with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack for a short trade. If you see Garen start the animation for Garen W Courage, delay Jax E Counter Strike’s reactivation by half a beat.
Garen.escape: The window to engage is right after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack is used. Garen has no ability to create distance, so close in with Jax Q Leap Strike and chain into Jax E Counter Strike’s stun. If you started the trade by walking up, save Jax Q Leap Strike to chase or escape.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly right after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack is used. Hit minions to build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks, then quickly chain basic attacks with Jax W Empower. Don’t stay in a prolonged fight while Garen E Judgment is spinning.
Garen.laning: Push or pressure the lane early to slow Garen W Courage’s growth, then create a numbers advantage elsewhere after pushing the wave.
Garen.phase: In the late game, Jax’s attack speed stacks and items also become stronger, but Garen W Courage permanently grows too, so limit the time he has to stack it from the start.
Garen.teamfight: Follow your allies’ engage or crowd control as the second one in. If there’s no reason to start a teamfight, push a side lane tower to draw opponents away to respond.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack silences you, so don’t engage first while it’s active. When Garen E Judgment starts spinning, don’t fight him for long; leave its range. Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage based on your missing health, so don’t stay in range if you’re below half health.

Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar’s main ability damage. If Gnar’s basic attacks are a threat, lower his attack speed with Frozen Heart to help you trade after Jax E Counter Strike. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Gnar.combo: To engage, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate E mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. If you use Q first, Gnar can escape with Gnar E Hop / Crunch, so activate E first. Once you’re in range, use W to reset your basic attack timer and quickly land the next attack.
Gnar.escape: Gnar E Hop / Crunch is Gnar’s only mobility, so right after you make him use it is your chance to engage. Right after Gnar changes from Mega to Mini, he also can’t transform again for a while, so look for an all-in with Jax E Counter Strike and Q Leap Strike. Check your position relative to walls first where Gnar R GNAR! is a threat.
Gnar.fight: Right after Mini Gnar uses Gnar E Hop / Crunch, close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike. Activate Jax E Counter Strike just before engaging to dodge basic attacks and line up the stun with your landing. Before trading, hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault.
Gnar.laning: Don’t use Jax E Counter Strike for a single ranged poke. If E is down, stay outside Gnar’s range until it comes back up, even if you have to give up CS. Step out of Mini Gnar’s boomerang path to make it harder for Gnar to catch it.
Gnar.phase: In the late game, Jax’s sustained attacks become stronger, so fight close to Mini Gnar during the window when he can’t transform again.
Gnar.teamfight: Avoid narrow terrain and positions with your back to a wall to deny Gnar R GNAR! a stun angle. If there’s no reason to start a teamfight, push a side lane tower to draw opponents away to respond.
Gnar.watch: Mini Gnar’s Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss can hit you on the way out and back, so step out of their path. When his rage fills and transformation is near, create distance and don’t take Mega Gnar’s explosive attacks head-on. Gnar R GNAR! stuns on wall impact, so don’t fight with your back to a wall.

Gragas.build: Gragas Q Barrel Roll, W Drunken Rage, and E Body Slam all deal magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance in your defensive build. If magic burst kills you first, use Banshee’s Veil to block an initial ability. Gragas W Drunken Rage deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Gragas.combo: After landing, attack with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Delay your burst briefly while Gragas W Drunken Rage is reducing damage.
Gragas.escape: The window to engage is right after Gragas E Body Slam is down. Close in with Jax Q Leap Strike and chain into Jax E Counter Strike’s stun. If Gragas E Body Slam hits an enemy, he can use it again soon, so avoid a deep chase unless you can secure the kill.
Gragas.fight: Hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault, then close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike after Gragas E Body Slam is down. Use Jax E Counter Strike against Gragas W Drunken Rage’s empowered basic attack, and activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms as you enter a fight to withstand ability damage.
Gragas.laning: When Jax E Counter Strike is down, farm from outside his range to limit your losses. Move out of Gragas Q Barrel Roll before it explodes, and avoid reckless chasing while accounting for healing from Gragas P Happy Hour. Watch your positioning so Gragas R Explosive Cask doesn’t knock you toward an enemy tower.
Gragas.phase: Gragas has strong burst and formation disruption in the early and mid game, so limit your losses in fights during this stretch.
Gragas.teamfight: Don’t leave your backline allies alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam, and watch narrow paths and bushes where you have no vision. If there’s no reason to start a teamfight, push a side lane tower to draw opponents away to respond.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, move outside its radius before it explodes. If you also get hit by Gragas E Body Slam near the barrel, the damage stacks, so don’t stand there and fight back. When Gragas is holding Gragas R Explosive Cask, don’t turn your back to the enemy turret or team.

Graves.build: Graves deals primarily physical damage, so prioritize Plated Steelcaps and armor. Armor does not block the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen. If an enemy basic attack damage dealer is carrying the game, Frozen Heart strengthens your trades after Jax E Counter Strike.
Graves.combo: When engaging, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first to line up the landing and stun, giving Graves less time to escape with Graves E Quickdraw or Graves R Collateral Damage.
Graves.escape: Don't engage just because Graves E Quickdraw is down; he can still escape with Graves R Collateral Damage. In particular, before Graves R Collateral Damage is back up, check whether he has any other movement options left, then engage with Jax E Counter Strike active and Jax Q Leap Strike. If you're caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its area first, then re-engage.
Graves.laning: Early on, push or pressure the lane to limit Graves's chances to build stacks on Graves E Quickdraw. If Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown, stay out of Graves's range even if you have to give up CS.
Graves.phase: Jax also scales well, but this matchup gets harder as Graves builds stacks, so it's important to limit his chances to stack from early on.
Graves.teamfight: Follow your allies' crowd control or engage as the second one in, activate Jax E Counter Strike in advance and use Jax Q Leap Strike to jump into the clustered enemies and look for an AoE stun. Keep a minion or ally between you and Graves to block his basic attacks, and avoid narrow passages where Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately on a wall. If there's no reason to start a teamfight, push a side lane turret to draw a response.
Graves.watch: Graves P New Destiny's basic attacks can be dodged with Jax E Counter Strike, but don't use Jax E Counter Strike just to answer one poke. Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits a wall, so fight in open areas. If you're caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave the area by the shortest route, then re-engage.
Graves.fight: Build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by hitting minions before fighting. You can block Graves’s basic attacks by keeping minions or an ally between you, and fight back or create distance while Graves reloads after firing two shots. In short trades, use Jax W Empower right after a basic attack to follow up quickly with your next basic attack.

Gwen.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Gwen's main ability damage. Also get armor to help against her basic attack physical damage; Frozen Heart is an option for reducing basic attack damage by lowering attack speed. Stacking only health increases the damage from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework, so dodge the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with movement rather than items.
Gwen.combo: Once Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, activate Jax E Counter Strike first and close in with Jax Q Leap Strike. Reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap to stun her around the time you land, then attack in this order: basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Use Jax W Empower before the first basic attack animation ends to quickly land the next one.
Gwen.escape: Right after you make Gwen use her mobility spell, Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, is your chance to engage. If Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is still available, start the trade by walking in rather than using Jax Q Leap Strike to close the gap, and save it for chasing or disengaging.
Gwen.fight: After that, build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault by hitting minions and take short trades while dodging the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Use Jax E Counter Strike against Gwen's basic attacks, but don't count on it to block her ability damage. For extended fights, activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms when you engage.
Gwen.laning: Avoid chasing in waves where Gwen E Skip 'n Slash frequently comes back after hitting minions. If needed, use the AoE damage from Jax E Counter Strike to push the wave and create a safe recall timing.
Gwen.phase: In the late game, Jax's stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault and items make him stronger in trades against opponents who rely on basic attacks.
Gwen.teamfight: Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms where you can hit multiple enemies to gain armor and magic resistance. If there's no reason to start a teamfight, push a side lane turret to draw away enemies who would respond.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals heavy true damage, so don't close in on Gwen when her Q has stacks; move sideways to dodge it. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on your maximum health, and Gwen R Needlework also slows. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can't target her from outside the mist, so enter it or wait until it ends.

Hecarim.build: Hecarim's main damage, Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge, is physical, so prioritize items with armor. Hecarim W Spirit of Dread and Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows deal magic damage, which armor alone can't block.
Hecarim.combo: When you're going in to reliably stun Hecarim, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Jax W Empower resets your basic attack timer, so use it before the first basic attack animation ends to quickly land the next one. If you use Jax Q Leap Strike first and activate Jax E Counter Strike late, Hecarim can escape with Hecarim E Devastating Charge or Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows.
Hecarim.escape: Don't engage just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down; check whether Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is also available.
Hecarim.fight: After that, build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault by hitting minions. When Jax E Counter Strike is available, start trades by walking in and save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or disengaging.
Hecarim.laning: Farm from outside Hecarim's range while Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown, and avoid pushing the lane too far early to account for Hecarim's rapid growth through the jungle.
Hecarim.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn't fear multiple of you at once. Follow your allies' engage or crowd control by activating Jax E Counter Strike first, then use Jax Q Leap Strike to jump into the clustered enemies and look for an AoE stun. If several of you fight for too long inside Hecarim W Spirit of Dread, you can help Hecarim heal, so end the fight quickly or move out of its area.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks you back farther the farther he has run, so break vision or move toward your allies when Hecarim turns and starts running. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple enemies at once, so keep your distance from allies in teamfights.

Illaoi.build: Illaoi deals primarily physical damage, so prioritize armor. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health. Account for Illaoi's healing by buying Executioner's Calling before diving.
Illaoi.combo: When closing in, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Use Jax W Empower immediately after a basic attack to quickly land the next one.
Illaoi.escape: Right after you make Illaoi use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is your chance to engage. If you dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit, the risk of getting caught is lower, so activate Jax E Counter Strike and engage with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Illaoi.fight: After that, build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault by hitting minions and fight when Jax E Counter Strike is ready. Right after Illaoi uses Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike and land the stun from Jax E Counter Strike.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave away from walls and last-hit from outside the range of Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Keep your distance and farm while Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown. If Illaoi E Test of Spirit hits and makes fighting difficult, break the tether. After becoming the vessel, dodge the first tentacle, then wait beside it for the mark to end.
Illaoi.phase: In the late game, make use of Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and your items, but don't fight where tentacles are set up.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don't group in front of Illaoi. If she uses Illaoi R Leap of Faith, spread out and wait out its duration. Break the tentacles or draw Illaoi into open ground away from walls.
Illaoi.watch: If Illaoi E Test of Spirit hits you, it leaves you slowed and marked, so dodge from outside its range if you don’t intend to fight. Illaoi R Leap of Faith is especially dangerous near tentacles, so spread out when she uses it and wait for her damage window to end.

Irelia.build: The information isn't enough to determine your first purchase. If Irelia's empowered basic attacks are threatening, lower her attack speed with Frozen Heart and use Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms to increase your armor and magic resistance.
Irelia.combo: After landing, continue with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack, and use Jax W Empower to cancel the basic attack animation.
Irelia.escape: Right after you make Irelia use Irelia Q Bladesurge is your window to engage with Jax Q Leap Strike. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, the risk of being stunned is lower. Activate Jax E Counter Strike before engaging and look to stun her before she can escape.
Irelia.fight: After that, build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault in advance and fight when Jax E Counter Strike is ready. If Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, that's your chance to close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Irelia.laning: Don't leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia can have a major impact in teamfights with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet, so focus her first. If there's no reason to start a teamfight, push a side lane turret to draw away enemies who would respond.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain across low-health minions to close in, so keep your distance when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you're trapped in the barrier from Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait for the blades to disappear.

Ivern.combo: Use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first so you can stun almost as soon as you land. If you use Jax Q Leap Strike first, Ivern can escape with Ivern Q Rootcaller.
Ivern.escape: Right after you make Ivern use Ivern Q Rootcaller is your chance to engage. If a target already has Ivern E Triggerseed on them, wait until the shield bursts before focusing them.
Ivern.fight: Close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike as soon as Ivern Q Rootcaller is down. Activate Jax E Counter Strike just before engaging to stun on landing, then use Jax W Empower after a basic attack to quickly land the next one. Don't count on Jax E Counter Strike to let you withstand Ivern's ability damage; activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms when you engage to gain armor and magic resistance.
Ivern.laning: Before a fight, build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault by hitting minions. Vision in Ivern's jungle early can reveal his route as he comes to collect camps, and don't casually walk by Ivern W Brushmaker when it suddenly appears.
Ivern.phase: In the late game, make use of Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and your items, but don't single out Ivern for a deep chase.
Ivern.teamfight: Engage on a target with Ivern E Triggerseed after the shield bursts, and take out the ally Ivern is protecting before Ivern. If there's no reason to start a teamfight, push a side lane turret to draw away enemies who would respond.
Ivern.watch: If you're hit by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern's allies can dash in, so keep a minion or terrain between you and him before he casts Q. Don't jump in immediately on a target marked by Ivern E Triggerseed, as it will soon slow. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, move away so you aren't hit three times in a row.
Ivern.build: Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Ivern's ability damage. However, if deaths occur when allies join in following the root from Ivern Q Rootcaller and the knock-up from Ivern R Daisy!, consider tenacity first. Choose Sterak's Gage if getting caught by crowd control means death, or Banshee's Veil if magic damage kills you first.

JarvanIV.build: If Jarvan IV's basic attacks are threatening, lower his attack speed with Frozen Heart.
JarvanIV.combo: Activate Jax E Counter Strike first to look for a stun right after landing. After the first basic attack, use Jax W Empower to reset your basic attack timer and quickly land the next one.
JarvanIV.fight: After that, build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault by hitting minions and fight when Jax E Counter Strike is available. Start trades against Jarvan IV when he's close by walking in, and save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or disengaging.
JarvanIV.laning: Farm from outside range while Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown. When you need a safe recall, push the wave with the AoE damage from reactivating Jax E Counter Strike.
JarvanIV.teamfight: If Jarvan IV uses Jarvan IV W Golden Aegis among several of your allies, deal your finishing damage after the shield is removed.

Jayce.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Jayce. However, magic resistance can't block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
Jayce.combo: When engaging Jayce, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first so you can stun almost as soon as you land and give Jayce less time to escape.
Jayce.escape: The moment Jayce's leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is down is your chance to close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike. Activate Jax E Counter Strike, then go in to land the stun. Also watch for the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow and choose your timing carefully.
Jayce.fight: Don't use Jax E Counter Strike for a single early poke from Jayce; save it for when you can commit to a fight. Before engaging, build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault by hitting minions, then use Jax W Empower between basic attacks to quickly chain them once you're on him.
Jayce.laning: Early on, farm defensively and accept Jayce's strong poke. Move side to side so you can dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast, and if Jax E Counter Strike is down, stay out of Jayce's range even if you have to give up CS. If your health gets low, don't overstay; clear the wave, then recall.
Jayce.phase: In the late game, make use of Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and your items to fight with consecutive basic attacks.
Jayce.teamfight: If the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, use the opportunity to get onto Jayce. If there's no reason to start a teamfight, push a side lane turret to draw away enemies who would respond.
Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, expect Jayce Q Shock Blast and dodge sideways out of its line. When Jayce has his hammer out, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow. Right after Jayce R Mercury Cannon switches his weapon, his first basic attack reduces your resistances, so dodge that attack with Jax E Counter Strike.

Karthus.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Karthus's damage. Consider Banshee's Veil first if magic burst kills you, to block the spell that starts it, and raise your magic resistance with Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms as you enter a fight. It is also important to avoid Karthus W Wall of Pain and quickly leave Karthus E Defile's range.
Karthus.combo: Then attack with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack, using Jax W Empower right after the first basic attack. If Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms is available, activate it as you enter the fight.
Karthus.escape: Engage when you have an angle for Jax Q Leap Strike to reach Karthus without passing through Karthus W Wall of Pain. After killing Karthus, immediately leave his corpse to avoid the spells he uses during Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.fight: Hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault, then look for an angle to close in with Jax Q Leap Strike. Use Jax E Counter Strike to look for a stun as you engage, but do not count on it to block Karthus's magic spell damage. Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms during the fight and follow your basic attacks with Jax W Empower to deal damage.
Karthus.laning: Do not use Jax E Counter Strike for a single bit of poke; save it for a committed engage or to respond to a gank, and avoid dangerous range while it is down, even if that means giving up CS.
Karthus.phase: Karthus catches up quickly with fast farming if you do not disrupt his growth, so do not force an engage later in the game just because you are relying on Jax's scaling.
Karthus.teamfight: Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms to raise your magic resistance as you engage, and do not stay in Karthus E Defile's range for long. Even if you kill Karthus, do not keep fighting near his corpse; reposition immediately.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals heavy damage when it hits you alone, so move near minions and dodge its telegraphed blast area. Passing through Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your magic resistance and slows you, so go around the wall to spend less time inside Karthus E Defile's range. After a fight, keep enough health to withstand Karthus R Requiem; if you kill Karthus, move straight away from his corpse to avoid the ability damage from Karthus P Death Defied.

Kayle.build: Build magic resistance first against Kayle's damage. Consider Banshee's Veil if magic burst kills you first. Kayle Q Radiant Blast reduces resistances, so avoid a direct hit instead of relying only on items.
Kayle.combo: Use Jax W Empower right after a basic attack to follow up quickly. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, unload your damage after the invulnerability ends.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility spell, so the window after you dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast and she uses Kayle W Celestial Blessing is a good time to close in.
Kayle.fight: Before fighting, hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault, and use Jax E Counter Strike in response to Kayle's basic attacks. Do not try to withstand Kayle's ability damage with Jax E Counter Strike; activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms as you enter the fight.
Kayle.teamfight: Find a direct route to Kayle from the flank or out of vision so she cannot keep attacking from the back. Do not unload your damage during Kayle R Divine Judgment's damage immunity; wait it out with a stun, then attack again.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces resistances, so avoid taking a direct hit. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade empowers her basic attack and deals damage based on your missing health, so dodge that attack with Jax E Counter Strike. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, do not unload your damage; use Jax E Counter Strike's stun to wait it out.

Kled.build: Build armor first since Kled's main damage is physical. If his basic attacks are threatening, Frozen Heart slows his attack speed and makes it harder for Kled to land all four hits of W Violent Tendencies. If you die while locked down by crowd control, gain survivability with Sterak's Gage.
Kled.combo: If you need to engage, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first and look to stun Kled as you land to reduce his chance to escape with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. For a short trade, use Jax W Empower right after a basic attack to reset your attack timer and fit in one more hit.
Kled.escape: Do not engage just because Kled E Jousting is down; check whether Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is still available. In particular, before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back, close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike and look to stun him with Jax E Counter Strike. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, use Jax Q Leap Strike to escape instead of waiting for the pull.
Kled.fight: Afterward, hit minions to build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault and fight when Jax E Counter Strike is ready. When Kled W Violent Tendencies activates, dodge his basic attacks with Jax E Counter Strike or create distance, then close in again.
Kled.laning: If Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown, farm outside Kled's range, and save Jax Q Leap Strike so you can escape if Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you. If you have knocked Kled off Skaarl, push dismounted Kled out of lane so he cannot build courage by killing minions.
Kled.phase: If you give up no early advantages and make it to the late game, fight by making use of Jax's passive stacks and items.
Kled.teamfight: Keep vision on the flanks since Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can come from out of vision. If there is no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies away to respond.
Kled.watch: Kled W Violent Tendencies concentrates damage based on your maximum health into its fourth basic attack, so create distance when it activates before taking all four hits. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, escape with Jax Q Leap Strike before it pulls you in. Just before dismounted Kled's courage meter fills, check whether you can prevent him from remounting; if not, create distance.

LeeSin.build: Lee Sin’s main damage, Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and R Dragon’s Rage, is physical, so build armor first. If Lee Sin’s basic attacks and attack speed are a problem, Frozen Heart helps you trade after Jax E Counter Strike ends.
LeeSin.combo: If you can walk up to him, save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing and trade briefly with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. If you need to dash in, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first so it’s easier to stop Lee Sin’s movement with a stun right after you land.
LeeSin.escape: After Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses, especially before he can use it again, you have a chance to close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike. Lee Sin can also escape with W Safeguard / Iron Will, so include the stun from Jax E Counter Strike. Focus your damage right after Lee Sin uses W Safeguard / Iron Will to engage, too.
LeeSin.fight: Hit minions to stack Jax P Relentless Assault before trading. At close range, activate Jax E Counter Strike when Lee Sin basic attacks to dodge them, then stun him and follow up with basic attacks and Jax W Empower. If Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or has not become available again, that’s your chance to engage.
LeeSin.laning: If you expect Lee Sin to engage, keep minions between you to block the direct line of Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike.
LeeSin.phase: Jax’s attack speed stacks and items come into their own later, so buy time by securing lane and objective advantages.
LeeSin.teamfight: Stand with a wall or your frontline behind you to prepare for Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage, but keep your distance from allies so you don’t collide with someone who gets kicked. If there’s no reason to start a teamfight, push a turret in a side lane to draw a response.
LeeSin.watch: Don’t give Lee Sin room to get behind you for R Dragon’s Rage.

Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against Malphite’s main damage: Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Consider Banshee’s Veil if magic damage is killing you first. If Malphite builds armor, use the max-health-based damage and magic damage from Jax E Counter Strike instead of trying to break through head-on with armor penetration.
Malphite.combo: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike before leaping so you stun Malphite almost as soon as you land, and use Jax W Empower to reset your basic attack timer.
Malphite.escape: Use Jax Q Leap Strike to close the gap and chain into the stun from Jax E Counter Strike. If Malphite R Unstoppable Force is still available, don’t chase too far relying only on the stun.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then hit minions to stack Jax P Relentless Assault and trade. If you can start the trade at close range, save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or escaping. Don’t force a fight if Malphite Q Seismic Shard has hit you or Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown.
Malphite.laning: When Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown, keep your distance and farm. If needed, use its recast’s area damage to push the wave and create a safe time to recall.
Malphite.phase: Later, you may lack damage against tanks like Malphite who build both health and armor, so avoid forcing a head-on fight.
Malphite.watch: After Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits, its slow makes it hard to engage or retreat, so don’t start a trade right away. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t be interrupted by the stun from Jax E Counter Strike, so don’t stand close to allies when Malphite’s location is unknown. Use Jax E Counter Strike to dodge Malphite W Thunderclap’s empowered basic attack, and time Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms with your engage to withstand his ability damage.
Malphite.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn’t knock up several of you at once, and fight back right after the ability is used. If there’s no reason to start a teamfight, push a side-lane turret to draw opponents away to respond.

MasterYi.build: Consider Frozen Heart if his basic attacks and attack speed are a threat, and build enough health to withstand the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style.
MasterYi.combo: After Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is down, activate Jax E Counter Strike first and close in with Jax Q Leap Strike. Recast Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap to stun him as soon as you land, then follow with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. If Master Yi activates W Meditate, interrupt it with the stun from Jax E Counter Strike.
MasterYi.escape: The moment after you make Master Yi use Q Alpha Strike is your chance to engage.
MasterYi.fight: Then hit minions to stack Jax P Relentless Assault, and activate Jax E Counter Strike in time with Master Yi’s basic attack animation. If you can get close, save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or escaping.
MasterYi.laning: Start trading after stacking Jax P Relentless Assault. You can use the area damage from Jax E Counter Strike to push the wave and create a safe recall window.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi also gets stronger as the game goes on, so don’t delay using the advantages you gained early.
MasterYi.teamfight: Group with your allies and layer crowd control so Master Yi doesn’t get the first takedown. Follow an ally’s engage or crowd control by activating Jax E Counter Strike first, then using Jax Q Leap Strike to go in and look for an area stun.
MasterYi.watch: While Master Yi casts Q Alpha Strike, he can’t be targeted, so look for him right after it ends and he lands. When Master Yi E Wuju Style is active, his basic attacks deal some true damage, and slow effects don’t work during Master Yi R Highlander, so respond with the dodge and stun from Jax E Counter Strike.

MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong’s main damage. It’s important to dodge the empowered basic attack from Wukong Q Crushing Blow with Jax E Counter Strike. If the enemy basic attack damage dealer is ahead, lower their attack speed with Frozen Heart.
MonkeyKing.combo: When engaging, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Going in this way after Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down makes it easier to land the stun. For a short trade, use Jax W Empower right after a basic attack to cancel its animation, then basic attack again.
MonkeyKing.escape: The window after Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down and before it comes back is your chance to close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike. If Wukong E Nimbus Strike is down too, he’ll have trouble escaping with his remaining mobility, so activate Jax E Counter Strike before going in. Look for a chance to fight right after Wukong R Cyclone is down as well.
MonkeyKing.fight: Afterward, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks in advance, trade briefly, then back off. The longer you fight, the more armor and healing Wukong P Stone Skin stacks up, so don’t let the duel drag on.
MonkeyKing.laning: Stay outside Wukong E Nimbus Strike’s range, and save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or disengaging when you trade. You can also use the area recast of Jax E Counter Strike to clear the wave and create a safe window to recall.
MonkeyKing.phase: In the late game, make use of Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and your items, but don’t stay in a prolonged fight with Wukong and let him stack Wukong P Stone Skin.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: Look for a chance to force an objective or fight right after Wukong R Cyclone is down.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so stay out of its range. After he closes in, Wukong Q Crushing Blow can reduce your armor, so activate Jax E Counter Strike to catch the empowered basic attack. Don’t use abilities on the stationary clone from Wukong W Warrior Trickster. If Wukong R Cyclone is ready, spread out from your allies.

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, his main damage. If the enemy’s basic attacks are threatening, consider lowering their attack speed with Frozen Heart. Armor is less effective inside Nasus E Spirit Fire, so move out of it.
Nasus.combo: For a melee trade, use basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. To close the gap and stun, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack.
Nasus.escape: It’s a good time to engage if Nasus W Wither is down and Jax E Counter Strike is ready. Nasus has no way to create distance on his own besides Flash, so close in with Jax Q Leap Strike and lock him down with the stun from Jax E Counter Strike. Don’t go deep alone while affected by Nasus W Wither.
Nasus.fight: Afterward, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by hitting minions, then trade when Jax E Counter Strike is ready. Stop fighting when Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.laning: Don’t push Nasus under his turret and let him last-hit freely with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Let the wave come toward your side, pressure his last hits, and call for a jungle gank. Farm from outside his range when Jax E Counter Strike is unavailable.
Nasus.teamfight: While Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, keep your distance instead of fighting him head-on. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw an enemy response.
Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike becomes threatening as it stacks, so don’t let him last-hit freely. Nasus W Wither lowers your movement and attack speed, so don’t stay alone within its range for long. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid a direct fight and wait out its duration.

Nidalee.build: Build magic resistance before armor against Nidalee’s damage. If magic damage is taking you down first, block her setup ability with Banshee’s Veil.
Nidalee.combo: Engage while Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce’s Pounce is down with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap.
Nidalee.escape: The moment after you bait out Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce’s Pounce is your chance to close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike. If Nidalee jumps in with Pounce after hitting you with her spear, have Jax E Counter Strike ready to look for a stun, but don’t count on it to block that spell’s damage.
Nidalee.fight: Fight after building Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by hitting minions. Don’t count on Jax E Counter Strike to withstand Nidalee’s spell damage, and activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms as you engage.
Nidalee.laning: If Jax E Counter Strike is down, stay out of range and give up CS if needed.
Nidalee.phase: In the late game, use Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and your items to keep up consecutive attacks.
Nidalee.teamfight: Remember where Nidalee stood when she threw her spear and look for an angle to engage. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to pull enemies away to respond.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss / Takedown’s spear deals more damage the farther it travels, so be especially careful to dodge it when Nidalee is far away. Move with minions between you and Nidalee, and dodge the traps from Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce so you don’t start a fight marked.

Nocturne.build: Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Nocturne Q Duskbringer, and Nocturne R Paranoia deal most of their damage as physical damage, so build armor first. If the enemy's basic attack damage dealer is carrying, use Frozen Heart to reduce their attack speed and help you trade back after Jax E Counter Strike. Armor can't block the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down, engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first so you can aim to stun Nocturne when you land. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, break the shield first with another ability, such as Jax W Empower, then reactivate Jax E Counter Strike.
Nocturne.escape: If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is still available, you may need Jax Q Leap Strike to break its tether, so don't spend it all on the engage.
Nocturne.fight: Then build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault by hitting minions, start trading with movement, and save Jax Q Leap Strike to chase or disengage. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is available, break it first with another ability, then look for a stun with Jax E Counter Strike.
Nocturne.laning: If Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown, farm from outside Nocturne's range and maintain vision around the river and jungle entrances. When you need a safe recall, you can push the wave with the area damage from reactivating Jax E Counter Strike.
Nocturne.phase: In the late game, your Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and items let you seek direct fights against opponents who rely on basic attacks.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, immediately move toward your allies so you aren't left as an isolated target. If there's no reason to start a teamfight, push a turret in a side lane to draw enemy players away to respond.
Nocturne.watch: Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror fears you if its tether stays connected, so keep Jax Q Leap Strike available to create distance as soon as it connects. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability and doubles his attack speed when it does, so don't use Jax E Counter Strike's stun right away. If you're hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, don't run straight along its trail; angle toward your allies or a turret.

Nunu.build: Get Executioner’s Calling early to counter the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume. Their main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, and get tenacity to deal with the snowball and root.
Nunu.combo: After landing, use basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Jax W Empower cuts off the basic attack animation so you can land the next hit faster.
Nunu.escape: Nunu & Willump has no skill to create distance on their own, so dodge the crowd control from the snowball and close in with Jax Q Leap Strike when you get an opening. Follow with the stun from Jax E Counter Strike to make it hard for Nunu & Willump to escape. Conversely, if you’re hit by Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage and a root is telegraphed, use Jax Q Leap Strike to escape instead of engage.
Nunu.fight: Afterward, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by hitting minions. If you can walk up to them, save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or disengaging. Don’t try to withstand Nunu & Willump’s spell damage with only Jax E Counter Strike; when you commit to a fight, activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms for resistances.
Nunu.laning: Keep watching the lane position, since another gank can come soon after the first.
Nunu.phase: In the late game, Jax’s attack speed stacks and items get stronger, but your damage may become increasingly insufficient against Nunu & Willump over time if they build both health and armor.
Nunu.teamfight: If Nunu & Willump casts Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero nearby, interrupt the channel with the area stun from Jax E Counter Strike. Follow an ally’s engage or crowd control by activating Jax E Counter Strike in advance and using Jax Q Leap Strike to enter where several enemies are grouped. If there’s no need to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to pull enemies away to respond.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up, so when you see it, dodge to the side toward the spot where Nunu & Willump just was instead of running straight backward. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, use Jax Q Leap Strike to escape before the delayed root triggers. Don’t stay in the slow zone of Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero for long; if it’s cast nearby, interrupt the channel with the stun from Jax E Counter Strike.

Olaf.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. If his basic attacks and attack speed are threatening, lower his attack speed with Frozen Heart. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that resistances can’t reduce, so build some maximum health too.
Olaf.combo: When engaging after Olaf R Ragnarok ends, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. If you can start a trade at close range, save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or disengaging, and use Jax W Empower right after a basic attack to land the next one faster.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no skill to create distance on his own, so when Olaf R Ragnarok ends and you get an opening, you can close in with Jax Q Leap Strike. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first, then go in and land its recast stun.
Olaf.fight: Afterward, start trades once you’ve built Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and Jax E Counter Strike is available.
Olaf.laning: Move away from where Olaf Q Undertow lands to hinder his axe retrieval. Before trading, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by hitting minions.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so get through that phase without giving him a kill.
Olaf.teamfight: Olaf can’t be stunned while Olaf R Ragnarok is active, so wait for its duration to end before going after him. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw an enemy response.
