Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow lowers armor and slows you. Move opposite the direction the axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. Olaf R Ragnarok makes the stun from Jax E Counter Strike ineffective, so keep your distance and use it after Ragnarok ends.

Ornn.build: Jax’s combat power rises sharply when he completes his first core item, so minimize losses and reach that point sooner. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so avoid building resistance to only one type. If Ornn’s crowd control is getting you killed, secure survival with Sterak’s Gage.
Ornn.combo: For a short trade, use basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack, resetting your attack timer with W right after the first attack. To stop Ornn from escaping, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast E mid-leap → basic attack → W → basic attack. Activate E first, because if you use Q first, Ornn can escape with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God.
Ornn.escape: Don’t engage just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down. The window after Ornn R Call of the Forge God is also down and before it returns is your chance to engage; close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike and land the stun from Jax E Counter Strike. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, fight after the effect ends.
Ornn.fight: Before trading, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by hitting minions. If you can walk up, save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or disengaging. Dodge the empowered basic attack after Ornn W Bellows Breath with Jax E Counter Strike, and keep your distance while Brittle.
Ornn.laning: If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, engage and attack to interrupt him. The area damage from Jax E Counter Strike can clear the wave and create a safe window to recall.
Ornn.phase: In the late game, Jax’s attack speed and item effects get stronger, but you may lack damage against Ornn if he stacks both health and armor, so use your early advantage to pressure the game.
Ornn.teamfight: Dodge the line between the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God and Ornn, and watch for the spirit’s return path after it passes. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to pull enemies away to respond.
Ornn.watch: Stand away from the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and from walls to avoid the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge. If the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath hits you and makes you Brittle, don’t move forward; keep your distance until the effect ends. When Ornn R Call of the Forge God starts, dodge the spirit to the side and move out of the line between the spirit and Ornn.

Pantheon.build: Build armor first against Pantheon’s main damage. If basic attack damage is a concern, lower his attack speed with Frozen Heart, but Pantheon W Shield Vault scales with your maximum health and Pantheon R Grand Starfall has penetration, so health or armor alone can’t block all his damage.
Pantheon.combo: Then use basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack, resetting your basic attack timer with Jax W Empower.
Pantheon.escape: Don’t give Pantheon W Shield Vault its stun range while it’s available. After both Pantheon W Shield Vault and Pantheon R Grand Starfall are down, engage with Jax E Counter Strike and Jax Q Leap Strike, especially before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back.
Pantheon.fight: Build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by hitting minions, and fight when Jax E Counter Strike is ready.
Pantheon.laning: Keep minions between you and Pantheon against Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke. You can use the area recast of Jax E Counter Strike to clear the wave and create a safe time to recall.
Pantheon.teamfight: Follow an ally’s crowd control or engage as the second one in, activating Jax E Counter Strike in advance and using Jax Q Leap Strike to jump into a group of enemies and look for an area stun. If you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area. When there’s no need to start a team fight, pressure a side lane turret.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so be careful not to give him its range. Keep minions between you and Pantheon when he pokes with Pantheon Q Comet Spear. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, stop attacking from the front and wait for it to end or move around to the side.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health pool alone. Don’t invest in magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Use Jax W Empower to reset your basic attack timer and fit in one extra attack quickly.
Poppy.escape: The moment after Poppy uses Poppy E Heroic Charge is an opportunity to close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, it blocks the dash, so wait for it to end. Then activate Jax E Counter Strike and engage to stun Poppy and stop her from disengaging.
Poppy.fight: After that, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by hitting minions, then walk up when Jax E Counter Strike is ready. Don’t keep fighting in the zone left by Poppy Q Hammer Shock.
Poppy.laning: Stand in open space without a wall behind you to avoid the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge. When Poppy’s shield lands, step on it first to prevent her from gaining a shield.
Poppy.phase: Late game, Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and items give you more power, but you may struggle to deal enough damage to Poppy as she builds both health and armor.
Poppy.teamfight: When Poppy charges Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of the frontal area. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw a response.
Poppy.watch: If you use Jax Q Leap Strike while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, the dash is blocked, so wait for it to end or walk up to her. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns if it knocks you into a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, leave the remaining zone immediately. When Poppy charges Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of the frontal area.

Quinn.build: Build armor rather than magic resistance against Quinn’s damage. If her basic attacks are a threat, consider Frozen Heart early to prepare for the trade after Jax E Counter Strike ends.
Quinn.combo: When Quinn E Vault is down, engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Press Jax W Empower before the first basic attack animation ends to get the next attack off quickly.
Quinn.escape: Quinn E Vault is her only mobility tool, so its use creates an opening to engage. Close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike and follow with the stun from Jax E Counter Strike.
Quinn.fight: Fight when Quinn E Vault is down or your jungler arrives. Once you’re on her, trade briefly with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack.
Quinn.laning: Early on, respect the range difference and preserve your health and CS. Back off when Quinn P Harrier marks you. Don’t use Jax E Counter Strike just to block a single instance of poke; save it for a committed engage or to respond to a gank. If Jax E Counter Strike is down, don’t stay in Quinn’s range for long, even if you have to give up CS.
Quinn.phase: Late game, Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and items can let you look for direct fights against basic attack reliant champions like Quinn.
Quinn.teamfight: If Quinn flanks, lock her down with the stun from Jax E Counter Strike. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw a response.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move out of basic attack range so you don’t get hit by her empowered basic attack. Quinn E Vault knocks back Jax’s engage and applies a mark, so don’t force an approach while it’s available. Stand behind minions to reduce the chance that Quinn Q Blinding Assault hits you first.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. If magic damage is killing you first, consider Banshee’s Veil; if crowd control is locking you down until you die, consider Sterak’s Gage.
Rammus.combo: Once Rammus R Soaring Slam is down and W Defensive Ball Curl has ended, engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Q Leap Strike → reactivate E mid-leap → basic attack → W Empower → basic attack. Use Jax W Empower right after the first basic attack to get the next one off quickly. Stop your basic attack sequence when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl activates.
Rammus.escape: Activate Jax E Counter Strike before engaging and land its stun to make it hard for Rammus to get away. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt hits you, plan to use Jax Q Leap Strike to disengage as soon as it ends.
Rammus.fight: After that, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks in advance and focus your damage after Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends. Don’t count on Jax E Counter Strike to withstand Rammus’s ability damage. Use the resistance increase from Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms when you enter a fight.
Rammus.laning: Keep minions in Rammus Q Powerball’s path and don’t start a fight from within Rammus E Frenzying Taunt’s range. Save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or disengaging if possible.
Rammus.phase: Late game, Jax’s successive basic attacks become powerful, but it can still take time to kill Rammus if he builds armor and health. Don’t keep attacking while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active.
Rammus.teamfight: Give Rammus R Soaring Slam plenty of room as he rolls in, then leave the slow zone at the landing spot. After an ally engages, activate Jax E Counter Strike in advance and use Q Leap Strike to enter where enemies are grouped, aiming for an area stun. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, attack someone else. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, pressure a side lane turret.
Rammus.watch: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, his defensive stats increase significantly and basic attacks against him take reflected damage, so stop attacking and wait for its duration to end. If you see Rammus Q Powerball coming, put minions between you and him ahead of time. Also leave the expanded landing area of Rammus R Soaring Slam and the slow zone that follows. You can’t dodge Rammus E Frenzying Taunt after it hits, so fight from outside its range.

RekSai.build: Build armor first to account for Rek’Sai’s main damage. If Rek’Sai’s basic attacks and attack speed are a problem, Frozen Heart lowers her attack speed. Resistance can’t stop the true damage from Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, but Rek’Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
RekSai.combo: When leaping onto Rek’Sai to stun her, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike during the leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first so the stun lands almost as you arrive, giving Rek’Sai less time to escape with Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek’Sai R Void Rush. Use Jax W Empower right after the first basic attack to get the next one out quickly.
RekSai.escape: The opening to fight comes after dodging the knock-up from Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. If only Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape with Rek’Sai R Void Rush, so check which movement ability she has left. Before Rek’Sai R Void Rush comes back, close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike and look to stun her with Jax E Counter Strike.
RekSai.fight: After that, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks in advance and fight when Jax E Counter Strike is ready. If you can start close, don’t use Jax Q Leap Strike first; save it for chasing or disengaging.
RekSai.laning: Keep Rek’Sai’s early and midgame ganks in mind: don’t push the lane too hard, and don’t cross areas without vision alone. Step on Rek’Sai tunnels you see near the lane to destroy them and limit her gank angles and escape routes.
RekSai.teamfight: Follow allied crowd control or engage. When leaping into a group, activate Jax E Counter Strike first, then approach with Jax Q Leap Strike and look for an area stun. Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms where you can hit several champions, including Rek’Sai, to maximize its armor and magic resistance. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies away.
RekSai.watch: When Rek’Sai uses W Burrow / Un-burrow to go underground, watch for the knock-up and move toward open ground. As she emerges, use Jax Q Leap Strike to create distance and avoid the knock-up. Since Rek’Sai R Void Rush can follow right after her poke hits, stay close to allies, and don’t use targeted abilities while Rek’Sai is leaping.

Renekton.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Renekton R Dominus. When empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces your armor, position to dodge the dash instead of stacking more armor.
Renekton.combo: After Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Q Leap Strike → reactivate E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → W Empower → basic attack. Activate E Counter Strike first to stun almost as you land, and use W Empower right after a basic attack to get the next one off quickly.
Renekton.escape: Close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike right after Renekton E Slice and Dice is down. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator is also used, this is your window to counterattack after the first combo; stun him with Jax E Counter Strike to prevent him from disengaging.
Renekton.fight: After that, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks, then fight when Renekton has no Fury or just after he uses Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice. If you can start a trade at close range, save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or disengaging.
Renekton.laning: Look for a trade when Renekton walks toward the minions to build Fury. You can also reactivate Jax E Counter Strike to push the wave and recall safely.
Renekton.phase: If you avoid giving up kills and keep scaling, the matchup starts favoring Jax from mid game onward, and his attack speed stacks and items become powerful late game.
Renekton.teamfight: Use Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms where you can hit multiple champions. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw opponents away.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is above or close to half full, watch for the stun from his empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. If Renekton E Slice and Dice hits a unit on its first dash, it unlocks a second dash, so don’t stand in or behind a minion wave.

Rengar.build: Rengar’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the enemy’s basic-attack damage is high, Frozen Heart lowers attack speed and helps you trade after Jax E Counter Strike. While Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt lowers your armor, the armor you’ve built is less effective.
Rengar.combo: If you can start a trade on foot, save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing and use basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack for a short trade. If you need to close the gap after Rengar W Battle Roar is down, engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike during the leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack.
Rengar.escape: Use Jax Q Leap Strike after dodging Rengar E Bola Strike. The opening comes when Rengar W Battle Roar is down and his resource bar is empty.
Rengar.fight: After that, hit minions to build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks, then fight when Rengar’s resource bar is empty and Rengar W Battle Roar is down. When Rengar starts a basic attack, activate Jax E Counter Strike and land the stun.
Rengar.laning: When Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths beside brush and use a Control Ward to reveal it. Build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks before trading.
Rengar.phase: In the late game, use Jax P Relentless Assault stacks to keep up basic-attack-focused fights.
Rengar.teamfight: Prepare for Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt by staying with allies and within vision, and keep the backline behind the frontline. After Rengar engages and Rengar W Battle Roar is down, catch him with the stun from Jax E Counter Strike. Jax should follow allied engage or crowd control as the second one in. When the enemy team is grouped, activate Jax E Counter Strike first, then leap in with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Rengar.watch: Rengar’s P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush and build resource, so avoid paths beside brush when Rengar is out of sight. With a full resource bar, Rengar’s E Bola Strike roots, while an empowered Rengar W Battle Roar removes crowd control, so don’t engage first while he’s in that state.

Riven.build: Riven’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, move defensive items earlier in your build. If you’re taking many basic attacks, consider Frozen Heart to lower her attack speed.
Riven.combo: If Riven still has a movement ability, activate Jax E Counter Strike first, then close in with Jax Q Leap Strike and recast Jax E Counter Strike during the leap to stun her almost as you land. Press Jax W Empower before the first basic attack animation ends to get the next basic attack out quickly.
Riven.escape: The opening comes after Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings on minions or to engage, before she can use it again. If Riven E Valor is still available, she can use it to escape, so don’t engage just because one movement ability is down. Right after Riven closes in, use Jax E Counter Strike to dodge her basic attacks and stun her, then close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Riven.fight: After that, hit minions to build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks, and activate Jax E Counter Strike when Riven closes in to weave in basic attacks. Save Jax Q Leap Strike to follow Riven’s escape or disengage instead of using it first.
Riven.laning: If Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions, she has spent both her main damage and an escape tool, giving you an opening to trade. Farm outside her range while Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown. If you first take a position that Riven has to pass through to return to her turret, it’s easier to land Jax E Counter Strike’s stun and follow up with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Riven.phase: In the late game, make use of Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and items to keep landing basic attacks.
Riven.teamfight: Follow allied crowd control or engage as the second one in. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw an enemy response.
Riven.watch: Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings three times in succession to move, and its third hit knocks you up, so move back when you see her first dash. Riven W Ki Burst stuns, while Riven E Valor grants a shield and can be used to escape. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her attack damage and range increase, and its recast deals damage based on your missing health, so create distance until it expires.

Rumble.build: Prioritize defensive items with magic resistance. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health. If magic burst kills you first, choose Banshee’s Veil.
Rumble.combo: When you have an opening to get on top of him, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike during the leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Use Jax W Empower right after the first basic attack to get the next one out quickly. If Rumble W Scrap Shield is active, wait briefly for the shield to fade before focusing your damage.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no movement ability, so the opening to catch him comes after he has also used Rumble W Scrap Shield. If you need to get out after being hit by the first cast, use Jax Q Leap Strike to disengage.
Rumble.fight: After that, trade briefly to avoid prolonged exposure to Rumble Q Flamespitter. If Rumble has activated Rumble W Scrap Shield, deal damage after the shield disappears. Attack minions before engaging to build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks.
Rumble.laning: Create a position where Rumble has to walk forward to trade, and don’t stay there if the first cast of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you. You can also use the area damage from Jax E Counter Strike to push the wave and create a safe recall window.
Rumble.phase: In the late game, Jax’s power rises with Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and items, but don’t assume you have the advantage against Rumble; limit your exposure to Rumble Q Flamespitter.
Rumble.teamfight: Follow allied crowd control or engage as the second one in. When you can hit several enemies, activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms to gain armor and magic resistance. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, pressure a side lane turret.
Rumble.watch: If the first cast of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you, use Jax Q Leap Strike to create distance before the second cast. Don’t rely on Jax E Counter Strike to withstand Rumble’s magic damage, and activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms when you engage.

Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North, Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, and Sejuani E Permafrost. Choose Banshee’s Veil if magic damage kills you first, or Sterak’s Gage if crowd control locks you down and gets you killed. Magic resistance can’t stop the physical damage from Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath.
Sejuani.combo: After Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike during the leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first so you can stun her as you land. Press Jax W Empower right after the first basic attack to get the next one out quickly.
Sejuani.escape: The opening to use Jax Q Leap Strike comes right after you bait out Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. After the stun from Sejuani E Permafrost is used, its stacks can’t build again for a short time, but avoid Sejuani’s first basic attack right after the stun.
Sejuani.fight: Before trading, hit minions to build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks, then walk up and use basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack for a short trade. Jax E Counter Strike dodges basic attacks, but don’t count on it to block Sejuani’s ability damage.
Sejuani.laning: Take a position that forces opponents to pass by Jax if they want to return to their turret; this makes it easier to follow up with a stun and chase.
Sejuani.phase: Jax’s repeated attacks become strong in the late game, but your damage may fall short if Sejuani builds both health and armor.
Sejuani.teamfight: When you can hit several enemies, activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms to gain armor and magic resistance. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies away.
Sejuani.watch: Dodge Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison by moving sideways when you see their tell. If the first hit of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath lands, get out of range before the second hit. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks can also build from her melee allies’ basic attacks, so create distance as the stacks rise.

Sett.build: Build armor first against the damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. If Sett’s basic attacks are threatening, consider Frozen Heart to reduce his attack speed. Resistance can’t reduce the center’s true damage from Sett W Haymaker, so focus on dodging to the side instead of relying on health or resistances.
Sett.combo: When Sett R The Show Stopper is down, attack with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first to stun as you land, and use Jax W Empower to reset your basic attack timer and fit in one extra attack.
Sett.escape: If you’ve positioned yourself where you can dodge Sett E Facebreaker, you’ve also reduced the risk of being stunned.
Sett.fight: After that, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by hitting minions, then fight by activating Jax E Counter Strike to match Sett’s basic attack animation. After dealing your damage, briefly back away and watch for Sett W Haymaker.
Sett.laning: If Jax E Counter Strike isn’t ready, farm from outside Sett’s range. To avoid being stunned by Sett E Facebreaker, avoid positions where minions are on the opposite side of Sett from you. When you need to recall safely, you can push the wave by reactivating Jax E Counter Strike for area damage.
Sett.phase: Late game, make use of Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and items to keep up sustained attacks.
Sett.teamfight: Avoid positions where Sett E Facebreaker can stun you, and stay out of the center of Sett W Haymaker. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw opponents away.

Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Choose Banshee’s Veil if magic damage kills you first, and Sterak’s Gage to survive if crowd control catches and kills you.
Shaco.combo: After Shaco Q Deceive is down, engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike during the leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Press Jax W Empower before the first basic attack animation ends to get the next attack out quickly.
Shaco.escape: The opening to close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike comes right after you bait out Shaco Q Deceive. Check approach paths without vision first so you can avoid the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box, then activate Jax E Counter Strike and leap in to look for a stun.
Shaco.fight: After that, hit minions to build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks, then, after Shaco Q Deceive is down, activate Jax E Counter Strike and close in with Jax Q Leap Strike. Don’t count on Jax E Counter Strike to withstand all the ability damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison. When you engage, use Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms to increase your armor and magic resistance.
Shaco.laning: Keep vision at your allied jungle entrance early to watch for Shaco ganks and invades. When Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown, farm outside range, and build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks before trading. After health has decreased, don’t pass through jungle or brush where you have no vision and Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison can hit you.
Shaco.phase: Shaco looks for an advantage through early ganks and invades, so avoid giving up kills, maintain vision, secure objectives, and buy time.
Shaco.teamfight: When Shaco uses Shaco Q Deceive to engage, he can’t immediately use the same ability to escape, so focus the real Shaco with your allies. Don’t waste damage on Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone: use its health bar response to identify the real one. When the clone dies, back away to avoid its explosion and fear.
Shaco.watch: The first basic attack after Shaco Q Deceive hits hard, so use Jax E Counter Strike to avoid it. Watch for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box around brush and objectives without vision, and check the area ahead of time with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens. Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone explodes and leaves a box when it dies, so back away as soon as you kill it.

Shen.build: Build tenacity first to prepare for the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t focus on only one type of resistance. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
Shen.combo: If Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, save your basic attacks until it ends.
Shen.escape: Right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses, Shen has neither his taunt nor a movement ability available, giving you an opening to engage.
Shen.fight: After that, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and fight. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike. After Shen W Spirit’s Refuge ends, deal damage with basic attacks and Jax W Empower.
Shen.laning: If you push the lane and keep Shen occupied with CS, you can make him lose out when he uses Shen R Stand United to influence another lane. You can also use the recast damage from Jax E Counter Strike to push the wave and create a safe recall window.
Shen.phase: Jax’s attack speed and items become strong in the late game, but your damage may fall short if Shen builds both health and armor.
Shen.teamfight: Alert your team immediately if you see the channel for Shen R Stand United or Shen disappear from lane, and avoid fights you can’t finish before Shen arrives. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret and use the opening in the lane Shen left when he uses Shen R Stand United.
Shen.watch: If taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you’ll take empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash. Also move out of the path of the Spirit Blade returning to Shen to reduce damage from Shen Q Twilight Assault. When Shen W Spirit’s Refuge appears, basic attacks are blocked, so wait for it to end.

Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, E Molten Burst, and R Dragon’s Descent. Her basic attacks also deal significant damage, so you need armor too; if the enemy’s basic attack damage dealers are strong, consider Frozen Heart to reduce their attack speed. Resistance can’t block the true damage from Shyvana Q Emberstrike, which also deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health pool alone.
Shyvana.combo: If Shyvana looks like she can escape, engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Press Jax W Empower before the first basic attack animation ends to get the next attack off quickly. If Shyvana engages with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, don’t try to stun her while she’s airborne; reactivate Jax E Counter Strike after she lands.
Shyvana.fight: After that, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks in advance, and activate Jax E Counter Strike to match Shyvana Q Emberstrike’s basic attack. Don’t try to withstand the ability damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and E Molten Burst with Jax E Counter Strike; activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms when you enter the fight.
Shyvana.laning: Pressure Shyvana early to make it harder for her to build permanent stacks from Shyvana P Scalemail. Before trading, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by hitting minions, and save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or disengaging.
Shyvana.phase: Because Shyvana P Scalemail grants permanent stacks, this matchup can become harder over time, so limit her stacks from early on.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so multiple people aren’t hit by Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent’s path and empowered area abilities. Wait until Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent lands, then stun her with Jax E Counter Strike and activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms as you enter the fight. Follow an ally’s engage or crowd control, then aim to hit multiple enemies with Jax E Counter Strike’s area stun.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana Q Emberstrike adds heavy damage to a basic attack, and Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and Shyvana E Molten Burst are also dangerous when fighting at close range. Shyvana is unstoppable while flying in with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, so apply the stun from Jax E Counter Strike after she lands. Don’t start an objective when Shyvana’s Fury gauge is full.
Shyvana.escape: A good time to engage is when Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is down or her Fury gauge is empty. Shyvana has no ability to create distance herself, so close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike and keep her in range with the stun from Jax E Counter Strike. If Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is ready, she can use it to disengage, so don’t rush to use Jax Q Leap Strike.

Singed.build: For your early purchase, prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling. Also get movement speed to leave areas covered in poison, and don’t stack only health because Singed E Fling deals damage based on your maximum health.
Singed.combo: If you can fight up close, use basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack for a short trade. To close the gap and stun him, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike during the leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. If Singed W Mega Adhesive is beneath you, you can’t leap, so leave the area first.
Singed.escape: The opening to engage comes after dodging Singed W Mega Adhesive and after he uses Singed E Fling. Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so close in with Jax Q Leap Strike and lock him down with the stun from Jax E Counter Strike.
Singed.fight: After that, fight when Jax E Counter Strike is ready, but don’t count on Counter Strike to block Singed’s magic damage too.
Singed.laning: Don’t follow Singed Q Poison Trail and take a long fight in the lane.
Singed.phase: Singed becomes harder to catch once he has his core items, so don’t chase him to the end through his poison in the late game either.
Singed.teamfight: Don’t send several players to chase Singed. If he runs toward your team, stun him with Jax E Counter Strike and attack his allies during that time. If you have an angle to stun several enemies, activate Jax E Counter Strike first, then leap in with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Singed.watch: Don’t chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. You can’t use Jax Q Leap Strike on Singed W Mega Adhesive, and if Singed E Fling hits you there, it also roots you, so go around the adhesive. If Singed is facing away from his allies, he can use Singed E Fling to throw you into their team, so check behind him too.

Sion.build: Build armor first against the damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Q Decimating Smash, and R Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor, so you need to dodge it even if you’ve built armor. Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about relying on a large health pool alone.
Sion.combo: When Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Jax W Empower resets your basic attack timer, so use it before the first basic attack animation ends. If you can start a trade at close range, save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or disengaging.
Sion.escape: Dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side to avoid its crowd control, then close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike and look to stun him with Jax E Counter Strike.
Sion.fight: After that, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by hitting minions, then fight after dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side or once Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down. When Sion activates Sion W Soul Furnace, focus your damage to break the shield before it explodes.
Sion.laning: If Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown, keep your distance and farm. Push the lane to disrupt Sion’s farming and stop him from freely gaining maximum health, or make gains in another lane. You can also use Jax E Counter Strike’s area damage to push the wave and create a safe recall timing.
Sion.phase: Late game, Jax’s attack speed stacks and items may still not be enough damage against Sion if he builds both health and armor, so don’t let him farm freely and stall the game.
Sion.teamfight: Follow an ally’s crowd control or engage. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first, then use Jax Q Leap Strike to jump into the group of enemies and aim for an area stun. If there’s no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw away opponents, including Sion. After taking Sion down, reposition instead of staying where Sion P Glory in Death revives.
Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash becomes more dangerous the longer it charges, so move sideways when the charge starts. Dodge Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught by moving to the side instead of running forward or backward, and avoid meeting him in narrow passages or along walls. It’s best to dodge Sion E Roar of the Slayer first because it reduces your armor.

Skarner.build: Decide early whether to buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to counter Skarner R Impale's suppression. Prioritize magic resistance, accounting for the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
Skarner.combo: If you can start in melee range, trade briefly with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. To engage, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike before leaping so Skarner can't escape with E Ixtal's Impact.
Skarner.escape: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is his mobility spell, so right after he uses it is your chance to engage with Jax Q Leap Strike. Chain Jax E Counter Strike's stun to keep Skarner from escaping. If Skarner R Impale is still available, account for the fact that Jax Q Leap Strike can't free you from its suppression before you go in.
Skarner.fight: Then build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by attacking minions, and activate Jax E Counter Strike to time with Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval's empowered basic attack. When Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Skarner.laning: Move through open areas without putting your back to a wall, so you can avoid a wall collision even if Skarner E Ixtal's Impact catches you. When you need a safe recall, you can use Jax E Counter Strike's area damage to push in the wave.
Skarner.phase: Late game, Jax's attack speed stacks and items come online, but Skarner can make your damage fall short if he builds health and armor.
Skarner.teamfight: Keep your distance so Skarner R Impale can't drag you deep toward his team, and don't stand right at the edge of an objective pit. If there's no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies away to respond.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact stuns you if it collides with a wall, so don't stand with your back to one. Use Jax E Counter Strike to dodge Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval's empowered basic attack. Skarner R Impale's suppression can't be escaped with Jax Q Leap Strike, so watch where you'll be dragged.

Taliyah.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and E Unraveled Earth. If magic damage is killing you first, use Banshee's Veil as a situational item to block an opening spell; if crowd control is locking you down and killing you, use Sterak's Gage to survive.
Taliyah.combo: After checking that there is no rock field on your approach, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap to land and stun her. Then attack with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack, using Jax W Empower's basic attack reset.
Taliyah.escape: If only one of Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and R Weaver's Wall is down, she can still escape with the other, so don't rush your engage. In particular, before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back, close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike when there's a path around rock field, and land Jax E Counter Strike's stun. Taliyah can't use R Weaver's Wall after taking damage, so keep attacking.
Taliyah.fight: Don't use Jax E Counter Strike for a single Taliyah poke; save it until you can reliably get on her. Check for a path without Taliyah E Unraveled Earth's rock field, then activate Jax E Counter Strike before engaging with Jax Q Leap Strike to land the stun. Don't count on Jax E Counter Strike to withstand Taliyah's magic spells; activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms when you enter the fight to gain armor and magic resistance.
Taliyah.laning: Before a fight, build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by attacking minions, and dodge Taliyah Q Threaded Volley by moving to the side. If Taliyah disappears from vision, she may interfere in another lane, so back off in advance.
Taliyah.phase: Late game, make use of Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and continuous basic attacks, but first find a path through Taliyah's crowd control.
Taliyah.teamfight: Follow up on an ally's crowd control or engage, activate Jax E Counter Strike in advance, and use Jax Q Leap Strike to jump into grouped enemies and aim for an area stun. Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms when you enter the fight to gain armor and magic resistance. If there's no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies away to respond.
Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can't change its cast direction, so sidestep instead of approaching in a straight line. Avoid using Jax Q Leap Strike across rock field, too.

Teemo.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the main damage from Teemo Q Blinding Dart, E Toxic Shot, and R Noxious Trap. If magic damage is killing you first, choose Banshee's Veil as a situational item.
Teemo.combo: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, activate Jax E Counter Strike first, then engage with Jax Q Leap Strike. Recast Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap to stun him, then deal damage with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack.
Teemo.escape: Right after Teemo uses Q Blinding Dart is your chance to fight with Jax's basic attacks.
Teemo.fight: Start trading right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is used. Build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by attacking minions, and if you plan to engage, dodge basic attacks with Jax E Counter Strike as you close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike. If blinded, don't force basic attacks; use abilities or back off.
Teemo.laning: Teemo E Toxic Shot's poison keeps dealing damage even after one basic attack, so stay out of range if you're not ready to engage. Don't use Jax E Counter Strike for a single ranged poke; save it for a sure engage or to respond to a gank. If Jax E Counter Strike is down, don't enter Teemo's range until it's available again, even if that means giving up CS.
Teemo.phase: Late game, use Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and your items, but watch for Teemo R Noxious Trap as you move through paths.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap from key paths, and assume there are traps near objectives and in narrow passages. If there's no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies away to respond.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart prevents Jax's basic attacks, so avoid trading basic attacks while the blind is still active. Jax E Counter Strike dodges basic attacks empowered by Teemo E Toxic Shot, but it doesn't block Teemo Q Blinding Dart's spell damage. Be careful around narrow paths and bushes without vision where Teemo R Noxious Trap may be waiting.

Trundle.build: Prioritize armor against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. If his basic attacks and attack speed are a threat, use Frozen Heart to lower his attack speed and help you trade after Jax E Counter Strike. Trundle R Subjugate steals resistances and deals damage based on your maximum health, so create distance while it's active instead of stacking only more resistances or health.
Trundle.combo: After landing, follow up with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack, using Jax W Empower to cancel the basic attack animation and fit in one more hit.
Trundle.escape: Trundle has no ability that lets him create distance on his own, so engage after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and the effect of Trundle W Frozen Domain has ended.
Trundle.fight: Then build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and fight when Jax E Counter Strike is ready. Avoid trading on Trundle W Frozen Domain or while Trundle R Subjugate is active.
Trundle.laning: Trundle P King's Tribute heals him when nearby units die, so don't keep the lane going while only chipping away at his health. If a trade gives you a health advantage, claim it immediately or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.phase: Late game, Jax is strong against opponents who rely on basic attacks, but create a team fight instead of facing Trundle alone in a long side lane duel.
Trundle.teamfight: While Trundle R Subjugate is active, attack someone else or create distance. Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms from a position where you can hit multiple champions.
Trundle.watch: On Trundle W Frozen Domain, his attack speed, movement speed, and healing increase, so back out and fight after the effect ends. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape route, so move to the side immediately when the pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, Jax is at a disadvantage after losing resistances, so create distance.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere's main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. If his basic attack damage is a problem, use Frozen Heart to lower his attack speed and prepare to trade after Jax E Counter Strike.
Tryndamere.combo: After Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. For a short trade at close range, use Jax W Empower immediately after a basic attack to cancel its animation, then land one more basic attack.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down is your chance to engage with Jax Q Leap Strike. Activate Jax E Counter Strike before Q, then recast it mid-leap to land the stun. If Tryndamere W Mocking Shout hits you, it reduces your attack damage, so don't start a basic attack fight right away.
Tryndamere.fight: Then build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks in advance, and trade only while Jax E Counter Strike is available. Activate Jax E Counter Strike when Tryndamere starts attacking, and chase with Jax Q Leap Strike when Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, poke Tryndamere to keep him from last-hitting, reducing his Fury and healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. When backing off, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout; if it hits, don't immediately start a basic attack fight.
Tryndamere.phase: Late game, Jax's P Relentless Assault stacks and items make him strong in head-on fights against opponents who rely on basic attacks, but when Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, wait for it to end before attacking.
Tryndamere.teamfight: If Tryndamere is pushing a side lane with R Undying Rage available, don't go stop him alone; trade for an objective or collapse on him as a group. If there's no reason to start a team fight, have Jax push a side lane turret to draw enemies away to respond.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury's critical strikes and Q Bloodlust's healing become more threatening as his Fury builds, so keep your distance when he builds Fury by attacking minions. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash's cooldown is reduced whenever he critically strikes, so don't chase him where there are lots of minions. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don't pour in damage; buy time with Jax E Counter Strike's stun or by creating distance.

Udyr.build: Prioritize armor. If Udyr Q Wilding Claw's basic attacks and attack speed are a problem, use Frozen Heart to lower his attack speed. Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals a mix of damage types, so armor alone can't block all his damage.
Udyr.escape: Right after Udyr uses E Blazing Stampede, that mobility spell is down, so close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike. During Udyr E Blazing Stampede's awakening, immobilizing effects don't work, so use Jax E Counter Strike's stun after the awakening ends. If you've already taken Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun once, it can't immediately affect the same target again during that window, so retaliate or escape with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Udyr.fight: Then build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks in advance, and fight when Jax E Counter Strike is ready. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle fades, pressure him and don't give him time to heal.
Udyr.laning: Udyr can appear from the jungle to gank, so ward key paths and jungle entrances, and don't move forward when he's out of sight. If you need a safe recall, you can use Jax E Counter Strike's area damage to push the wave.
Udyr.phase: Late game, Jax becomes strong in trades against opponents who rely on basic attacks, but it can take time to kill Udyr when he builds both armor and health.
Udyr.teamfight: Don't force a kill on Udyr while he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle; target a weaker opponent behind him first. If there's no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies away to respond.
Udyr.watch: When Udyr activates E Blazing Stampede again, watch for the stun on his first hit. Udyr Q Wilding Claw empowers basic attacks and deals damage based on maximum health, so time Jax E Counter Strike to dodge it when trading. Don't count on Jax E Counter Strike alone to withstand the area magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm; activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms when you enter the fight.

Urgot.build: Prioritize armor against the main physical damage from Urgot P Echoing Flames, Q Corrosive Charge, and W Purge. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking only health, and also consider your total health when trying to stay above Urgot R Fear Beyond Death's execute threshold.
Urgot.combo: When Urgot E Disdain is down, engage with Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → recast Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first to land and stun him, then use Jax W Empower to reset your basic attack timer and attack in quick succession.
Urgot.escape: Right after Urgot uses his only mobility spell, E Disdain, is your window to engage. If you need to disengage after being hit by Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, use Jax Q Leap Strike instead of relying on walking.
Urgot.fight: Build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks by attacking minions before starting a fight. Once you're on him, deal your damage with basic attacks and Jax W Empower before Urgot P Echoing Flames damage builds up.
Urgot.laning: If Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown, don't enter Urgot's range, even if that means giving up CS. If Urgot approaches with W Purge active, walk away to create distance.
Urgot.phase: Late game, fight by making use of the way Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and items work together.
Urgot.teamfight: Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so a frontline ally standing in front can protect allies behind them. If there's no reason to start a team fight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies away to respond.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on maximum health, and the damage from his leg cannons builds the longer you stay near him, so remain outside their short range. Urgot Q Corrosive Charge slows you and focuses the fire from Urgot W Purge, so decide immediately whether to escape with Jax Q Leap Strike when it comes at you. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of its range before you reach the execute threshold.

Vi.build: Vi's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Vi W Denting Blows reduces armor and deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. If the enemy's basic-attack damage dealers are strong, lower their attack speed with Frozen Heart. If you die after being caught by crowd control, choose Sterak's Gage.
Vi.combo: When engaging, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first to aim for a stun on landing, but make Vi use Vi Q Vault Breaker first if it is still available. In short trades, use Jax W Empower immediately after a basic attack to reset its timer and land another basic attack.
Vi.escape: Vi Q Vault Breaker is her mobility tool, so the moment after she uses it is your chance to engage with Jax Q Leap Strike. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first as you approach to dodge Vi's basic attacks and aim for a stun. If Vi engages with Vi R Cease and Desist, respond after the knock-up ends.
Vi.fight: Before trading, hit minions to build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks. Use Jax E Counter Strike against Vi's basic attacks and attacks empowered by Vi E Relentless Force, then stun her, trade briefly, and back away. If Vi engages with Vi P Blast Shield active, wait for the shield to wear off before trading.
Vi.laning: After making Vi use Vi Q Vault Breaker, look for a chance to close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Vi.phase: In the late game, make use of Jax P Relentless Assault's attack speed stacks, but don't let Vi W Denting Blows stack up by taking extended fights.
Vi.teamfight: Follow up on an ally's crowd control or engage as the second one in, then activate Jax E Counter Strike and use Jax Q Leap Strike to jump into a cluster of enemies and aim for an area stun. Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms when you can hit multiple champions to gain armor and magic resistance. If you don't need to start a teamfight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies away to respond.
Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage when fully charged, so move back or to the side when you see her charging. Vi W Denting Blows reduces armor and increases attack speed with repeated attacks, so avoid extended trades. Vi R Cease and Desist cannot be dodged with Flash, so if you react to Vi engaging, wait until the knock-up ends.

Viego.build: Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker deal mainly physical damage, so build armor first. If Viego's basic attacks are threatening, lower his attack speed with Frozen Heart. If Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King's healing become a problem in extended duels, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances.
Viego.combo: When committing to an engage on Viego, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike before leaping so you can stun Viego immediately on landing and limit his chance to escape with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. Press Jax W Empower before the basic-attack animation ends to land the next basic attack quickly.
Viego.escape: If only Viego W Spectral Maw is down, Viego can still escape with Viego R Heartbreaker, so don't rush your engage. If both mobility tools are down, or especially before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back up, close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike and lock him down with Jax E Counter Strike.
Viego.fight: Afterward, hit minions to build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and trade when Jax E Counter Strike is ready. If you can start nearby, save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or escaping.
Viego.laning: If Viego E Harrowed Path leaves black mist over terrain, don't push the lane toward it. Place a Control Ward or go around the path. You can also use Jax E Counter Strike's area damage to clear the wave and create a safe recall window.
Viego.phase: In the late game, Jax is well suited to facing basic-attack-focused champions head-on with Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and his items.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it is charged, so move to the side when you see him charging and interrupt it with Jax E Counter Strike's stun if you can reach him. When your health is low, back away because Viego R Heartbreaker can easily target you. If you see black mist over terrain, watch for Viego E Harrowed Path and avoid that area.
Viego.teamfight: If an ally falls near Viego, don’t continue fighting there; push him away from the wraith or lock him down so he can’t reach it. If Viego possesses someone, keep your distance and hold on; use the moment he returns to his original body as an opportunity to fight back.

Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. If his basic attacks and attack speed are a problem, lower his attack speed with Frozen Heart. If Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing is a problem, consider an anti-healing item.
Volibear.combo: When you need to close the gap, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first and stun him almost as you land to limit Volibear's chance to escape with Q Thundering Smash or R Stormbringer.
Volibear.escape: Don't engage just because Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down. If Volibear R Stormbringer is also not back up, activate Jax E Counter Strike and close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike to aim for a stun.
Volibear.fight: Afterward, hit minions to build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and fight just after Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks fall off. At close range, start trading on foot and save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing or escaping.
Volibear.laning: Disengage from inconclusive fights that give Volibear room to heal with Volibear W Frenzied Maul. If your health is low, watch out for Volibear R Stormbringer even under your turret. You can use Jax E Counter Strike's area damage to clear the wave and create a safe recall window.
Volibear.phase: In the late game, Jax's attack speed stacks and items become powerful, but you may lack damage against a Volibear who builds both health and armor.
Volibear.teamfight: Follow up on an ally's crowd control or engage. Activate Jax E Counter Strike ahead of time and use Jax Q Leap Strike to jump into a cluster of enemies and stun several of them. If you don't need to start a teamfight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies away to respond.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash stuns with an empowered basic attack, so use Jax E Counter Strike to dodge it as he approaches or stay out of basic-attack range until it ends. When you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, walk to the side to avoid its damage and slow. When your health is low, retreat deeper under your turret because Volibear R Stormbringer can disable it briefly.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress. If duels run long, reduce his healing with Executioner's Calling. Build armor too if his basic-attack damage is a problem.
Warwick.combo: When engaging, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first to stun him almost as you land, then use Jax W Empower right after the first basic attack to land the next one quickly.
Warwick.escape: If only Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down, he can still escape with Warwick R Infinite Duress, so don't rush your engage. In particular, when Warwick R Infinite Duress is not back up and Warwick E Primal Howl's fear is also down, activate Jax E Counter Strike and close in with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Warwick.fight: Before trading, hit minions to build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks. Use Jax E Counter Strike against Warwick's basic attacks, but don't count on it to block Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast or R Infinite Duress. Re-engage after Warwick E Primal Howl ends and trade briefly with basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack.
Warwick.laning: When your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position and makes Warwick faster, so recall even if you have to give up some farm.
Warwick.phase: In the late game, use Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and items to look for basic-attack-focused fights.
Warwick.watch: Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses Jax, so engage carefully until it is down. While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and can fear you, so back away and re-engage after the fear is used.
Warwick.teamfight: If an ally is caught by Warwick R Infinite Duress, focus your counterattack while Warwick is held in place. If there’s no reason to start a teamfight, push a side-lane turret to draw opponents over to respond.

XinZhao.build: Build armor first against Xin Zhao's main damage. If his basic attacks and attack speed are threatening, lower his attack speed with Frozen Heart to help you trade after Jax E Counter Strike ends.
XinZhao.combo: When engaging, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first to stun him almost as you land, then press Jax W Empower right after the first basic attack to land the next attack quickly.
XinZhao.escape: The moment after making Xin Zhao use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is your chance to engage with Jax Q Leap Strike. Use Jax E Counter Strike at the same time to dodge his basic attacks and aim for a stun.
XinZhao.fight: Afterward, build passive stacks and fight when Jax E Counter Strike is available. If Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike.
XinZhao.laning: When Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown, farm from outside his range. Before trading, hit minions to build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks.
XinZhao.watch: Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's third basic attack knocks you up, so if he has hit you twice with empowered attacks, activate Jax E Counter Strike before the third or use Jax Q Leap Strike to get out of range. Move to the side to dodge the follow-up thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning.
XinZhao.teamfight: While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don’t force damage; fight back when it ends.

Yasuo.build: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath deal most of his damage as physical damage, so build armor first. If the enemy's basic attack damage dealer has become a threat, use Frozen Heart to reduce their attack speed and help you trade back after Jax E Counter Strike. Armor won't block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: For a short trade, use basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack, cancelling the basic attack animation with Jax W Empower to fit in one extra hit. When you're sure you can engage, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. If you can start the trade up close, save Jax Q Leap Strike to follow Yasuo E Sweeping Blade or escape.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, Yasuo Q Steel Tempest's stacks reset, giving you an opening to engage. Don't engage just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade alone is down. Wait for an opening when Yasuo R Last Breath also can't be used, then use Jax E Counter Strike's stun and Jax Q Leap Strike together.
Yasuo.fight: Then build stacks of Jax P Relentless Assault by hitting minions and fight when Jax E Counter Strike is ready. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he briefly has no way to knock you up, giving you an opening to engage.
Yasuo.laning: First remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield with light damage, then trade in earnest. Keeping a thin wave near your side reduces the number of minions Yasuo can use as stepping stones to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.phase: In the late game, use your Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and items to seek direct fights against opponents who rely on basic attacks.
Yasuo.teamfight: Activate Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms where you can hit multiple enemies to gain more armor and magic resistance. When there's no reason to start a teamfight, push a turret in a side lane to draw enemy players away to respond.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so move sideways to dodge as he approaches. After he hits it twice in a row, his next Yasuo Q Steel Tempest becomes a tornado that knocks you up, so watch for the sound and visual effect. Yasuo can approach by dashing through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, and if you're airborne, he can follow up with Yasuo R Last Breath.

Yone.build: If Yone's basic-attack damage is threatening, consider Frozen Heart first to lower his attack speed. The attack speed reduction also slows how quickly Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone W Spirit Cleave come back up. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don't invest in only one type of resistance.
Yone.combo: When engaging to prevent Yone from escaping, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack. Activate Jax E Counter Strike first so you can stun him on landing and limit the time he has to escape with a mobility ability. Jax W Empower resets the basic-attack timer, so press it before the preceding basic-attack animation ends.
Yone.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Yone's Yone Q Mortal Steel tornado disappears and he uses Yone E Soul Unbound or Yone R Fate Sealed. Yone can still escape with his other mobility ability when one is down, so aim especially for the window before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up. Activate Jax E Counter Strike, close in with Jax Q Leap Strike, and stun him.
Yone.fight: Afterward, hit minions to build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and fight, but keep your distance if Jax E Counter Strike is unavailable. If Yone engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, look for a chance to stop his return with Jax E Counter Strike's stun.
Yone.laning: Back away when Yone's tornado Q is ready, and farm out of range while Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown. You can also use Jax E Counter Strike's area damage to clear the wave and create a safe recall window.
Yone.phase: In the late game, Jax can fight basic-attack-focused opponents head-on with strength using Jax P Relentless Assault stacks and his items.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave's shield doesn't grow, and check your position in the formation relative to the path of Yone R Fate Sealed. If there's no reason to start a teamfight, push a side lane turret to draw enemies away to respond.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, wait out of range until the stacks disappear. After he engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, he can deal extra damage when he returns, so back away in advance if your health is low. In teamfights, spread out so several allies don't get hit by Yone W Spirit Cleave together.

Yorick.build: Build armor first against Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers' physical damage. If you keep getting hit by Yorick's basic attacks, lower his attack speed with Frozen Heart. Avoid stacking health alone because Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal damage based on your maximum health.
Yorick.combo: If you can start a trade on foot, save Jax Q Leap Strike for chasing and use basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack.
Yorick.escape: Yorick has no ability to create distance on his own, so after dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, look for a chance to close in with Jax Q Leap Strike. If Yorick W Dark Procession is down or you see a path over it, activate Jax E Counter Strike and engage to dodge the basic attack empowered by Yorick Q Last Rites.
Yorick.fight: Afterward, hit minions to build Jax P Relentless Assault stacks, clear Yorick's Mist Walkers, and fight when Jax E Counter Strike is ready.
Yorick.laning: Don't fight where many graves have accumulated around Yorick. If possible, push the wave so it's harder for Yorick to build graves on his side.
Yorick.teamfight: If there's no reason to start a teamfight, apply side-lane pressure, but account for the objectives your team can take elsewhere and the players needed to respond to Yorick's side-lane pressure.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on your maximum health, so dodge its arc. If the Maiden of the Mist from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking Jax, back away from Yorick himself. If you're trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, hit the wall to break it or look for a path over it with Jax Q Leap Strike.

Zac.build: Build magic resistance before armor against the damage from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, Zac W Unstable Matter, and Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If magic damage kills you first, use Banshee's Veil to block an initiating ability. If you die after being caught by crowd control, consider Sterak's Gage. Be careful about stacking health alone because Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on your maximum health.
Zac.combo: If Zac can escape with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and you still engage, use Jax E Counter Strike → Jax Q Leap Strike → reactivate Jax E Counter Strike mid-leap → basic attack → Jax W Empower → basic attack.
